rationale: tv_iterative_supervised-claude-agentic: val_n=214, val_chunk=5, train_n=40, epochs=8, batch_size=1, lr=0.05, tv_K=30, tv_step_init=1e-05, tv_lambda_init=0.001, tv_share_steps=True, tv_clip_max=0.05, tv_eps=1e-06, lambda_neg=1.0, loss_base=mse, grad_clip=1.0, rationale=tv_iterative_supervised iter-5 (search-20260619-01, corrected 214-slice/321px-FOV metric). PRIOR TRAJECTORY (SSIM/hr): iter-1 K=10 0.2855/0.0; iter-2 K=30 0.2855/0.0 (byte-identical: depth FALSIFIED); iter-3 step=1e-8 0.8137/0.0 (LD-FBP PASSTHROUGH: loss flat 6.4e-5, lambda PINNED, step crept 1.06e-8->1.76e-8 -> near-identity on fbp_init, recon PSNR 33.60 just BELOW baseline 34.08); iter-4 step=1e-5 0.6949/0.0 PSNR 21.83. BEST hr = 0.0 across all 4; best SSIM = iter-3 0.8137 (but that is pure FBP passthrough, not a trained recon). BASE_ITER=4 (the ONLY iter where training actually un-froze). LIMITER (from iter-4 SLURM log 765355, the decisive evidence): at step_init=1e-5 the 60 free scalars FINALLY trained for real -- loss DROPPED 5.2e-5->2.8e-5 (first real decrease in the campaign), lambda[k] DEPARTED init (0.001->0.00111..0.00239), step[k] adapted. BUT SSIM got WORSE (0.8137->0.6949) and PSNR collapsed to 21.83. Root cause: with tv_share_steps=False the 30 INDEPENDENT per-iter log_step scalars are free to RUNAWAY -- step[1] exploded 6.3e-5->0.031 (epoch5-8), driving that single unrolled iterate back into the SATURATED-CLAMP regime that iter-1/2 proved kills the recon. The supervised-L2 loss decreased while SSIM/PSNR worsened = a degenerate per-step-instability basin (one runaway step the masked-L2 tolerates but the recon does not). The limiter is NO LONGER step scale (1e-5 IS the active training basin) NOR depth NOR epochs/lr -- it is the UNCONSTRAINED PER-STEP DEGREE OF FREEDOM letting individual steps diverge into the clamp. ONE KNOB CHANGED (from BASE_ITER=4): tv_share_steps False -> True (60 free scalars -> 2 shared scalars: ONE step + ONE lambda applied uniformly across all K=30 unrolled iterations). All else IDENTICAL to iter-4 (tv_step_init=1e-5 KEPT -- it is the confirmed active basin; tv_K=30, train_n=40, epochs=8, bs=1, lr=5e-2, tv_lambda_init=1e-3, tv_clip_max=0.05, tv_eps=1e-6, val_n=214 ALL L277, val_chunk=5, grad_clip=1.0). HYPOTHESIS: a SHARED step/lambda cannot have a single runaway iterate -- it forces a uniform, stable K=30 GD that stays inside the [0,0.05] clamp basin while still TRAINING (the iter-4 log proved the scalars receive real gradient at step=1e-5). I expect SSIM to RECOVER above the 0.6949 iter-4 collapse and the trained-stable TV to finally exceed its own LD-FBP passthrough (SSIM > 0.8137, hr > 0) because the one trainable step now optimizes the data-vs-TV balance globally without any step being allowed to blow into clamp saturation. NUMERIC FALSIFIER (decisive): if SSIM stays <= 0.8137 with hr=0 (the shared step ALSO converges to either the passthrough floor (step->0) or the clamp ceiling (step->over-large), i.e. there is NO single shared step value in [0,0.05]-clamp-basin that both trains AND beats FBP), then the supervised-unrolled-TV harness is STRUCTURALLY FBP-BOUNDED on real Mayo 2304-view LDCT under the config-only contract (the shared solvers raw unnormalized-adjoint back_project step is FORBIDDEN to edit) -> file the NEGATIVE RESULT and STOP iterating this solver at iter-5. BUDGET (HARD 20-min train+score=1200s): IDENTICAL compute to iter-4 (tv_share_steps changes ONLY the scalar COUNT 60->2, not any loop size: same K=30, train_n=40, epochs=8, bs=1, val_n=214, val_chunk=5) -> ~918s measured iter-4, ~282s margin under the 1200s wall; sbatch --time=00:30:00 carries figure/IO headroom. PREDICTED iter-5: SSIM ~0.81-0.86, hr most-likely 0.0 (predicted ceiling MECHANISM if hr stays 0: the supervised-L2 + unnormalized 2304-view adjoint step has no shared scalar that both escapes the FBP-passthrough basin AND stays out of clamp saturation -- the trained-stable TV recovers toward the FBP floor but cannot strictly EXCEED its own LD-FBP because the only image-domain prior is a single global TV weight, structurally weaker than the LDCT noise it must remove). If hr>0, supervised-TV is repaired and iter-6 raises train_n (capacity is tiny -- 2 scalars -- so data lever is weak, weigh carefully).
